title: MUSCLE MANGA - Retsu Kaioh's Physique in Grappler Baki
summary: Character and physique study of Retsu Kaioh, the kung fu grandmaster of Grappler Baki: his pride in 4,000 years of Chinese kenpo, his barrel-chested, five-heads-wide physique, his training feats and his defeat by Baki. NH reads him as a subversion of the calm Shaolin monk archetype.
claims: Retsu at 5 ft 10 and about 235 lb has massive lats and pecs that make him look barrel-chested, huge traps, bodybuilder arms and a six-pack, far beyond Bruce Lee's small aesthetic build
Realistic male shoulders fit about three head widths and the heroic canon four; Retsu's fit five, giving an uncanny look
Much of Retsu's buff look comes from huge ribcage expansion that makes the torso look like a cobra's hood
He cherishes manga flashbacks of brutal training, such as pounding an obsidian rock into a sphere, above everything else
A big enough neck lets you run your mouth as much as you want
